==Biography==
Eduardo Franco Garcés Cerda started playing League of Legends in Season 1. In Season 2 he realized that he got good mechanics as support and decided that this would be his main role. Then he  began to gain recognition for his playstyle and teams started asking him to tryout.

=== 2014 Season===
His debut was in [[Team LGL]] as Support participating in minor tournaments, in August of that year he leaves the team.

At the end of the year he joins [[ChiLeanFivE]] as an sustitute Support without participating in any tournament, at the end of the year he leaves the team.

=== 2015 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Rebirth eSports]] as Support by participating in the [[LAS 2015 Opening Cup Promotion]] where the team was fifth in the tournament, qualifying for the LAS Cup. In the [[LAS 2015 Opening Cup]] the team was last in the tournament, having to play the relegation. Already in the [[LAS 2015 Closing Cup Promotion]] the team faces [[Isurus]] winning 3-0, saving their place. At mid-year [[Slow]] he remains in the team participating in the [[LAS 2015 Closing Cup]] where the team was fourth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LAS 2015 Closing Cup Playoffs]] the team was third in the tournament facing [[Last Kings]] winning 2-1.

=== 2016 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Slow]] remains in the team participating in the [[LAS 2016 Opening Cup]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LAS 2016 Opening Cup Playoffs]] the team was fourth in the tournament facing [[Last Kings]] losing 0-3. At mid-year [[Slow]] he remains in the team participating in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup]] where the team was fifth in the tournament.

=== 2017 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Slow]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Opening]] where the team was fourth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Opening Playoffs]] where the team was fourth in the tournament facing [[Furious Gaming]] losing 1-3. At the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

In the middle of the year he joined [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] as Support by participating in the [[CLS 2017 Closing]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying for the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Isurus]] winning 3-1, being champion for the first time, qualifying for the first time to an international tournament. Already in the World Cup the team was in group C facing [[Fnatic]] from Europe and [[Young Generation]] from Vietnam, where the team was last in the group stage.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Slow]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[Rebirth eSports]] winning 3-2, qualifying the MSI. Already in the MSI the team was in group A facing [[Gambit Esports]], [[Rainbow7]] and [[Ascension Gaming]], where the team was last in the group phase. At the middle of the year [[Slow]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] where the team reached the final again [[Rebirth eSports]] beating 3-1, qualifying for the World Cup. Already in the World Cup the team was in group D facing [[G-Rex]] and [[Gambit Esports]], where the team was last in the group phase, at the end of the tournament leaves the team.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joined [[Isurus]] participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] where the team was fourth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Opening Playoffs]] where the team reached the final facing [[Rainbow7]] winning 3-1, qualifying the MSI. Already in the MSI the team was in group A facing [[Phong Vũ Buffalo]] from Vietnam, [[1907 Fenerbahçe]] from Turkey and [[Bombers]] from Oceania, the team was last in the group stage together with [[Bombers]]. In the middle of the year [[Slow]] he remains in the team participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Closing Playoffs]] the team reached the final facing [[All Knights]] winning 3-0, qualifying for the World Cup. Already in the World Cup the team was in group B facing [[DetonatioN FocusMe]] from Japan and [[Splyce]] from Europe, where the team was second in the group phase, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the playoffs the team faces [[Hong Kong Attitude]] losing 1-3.
